title: CXAI) Announces Webcast Details for 3rd QTR 2026 Financial Results
summary: CXAI launches Beat, an AI agent that finds stalled work, prepares the next step and acts on your approval. Free in beta. Live demos at SF & LA Tech Week.
body_markdown:
****Chairman and CEO Khurram Sheikh will host the live call on Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time / 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time; investors may register now and submit questions through the webcast****


**PALO ALTO, CA /[ACCESS Newswire](https://www.accessnewswire.com/) / November 2, 2026 /**[CXApp Inc.](https://pr.report/t1gi) **(NASDAQ:CXAI), an enterprise agentic AI platform company, today announced** the webcast and dial-in details for its conference call to discuss financial results for the third quarter ended September 30, 2026 and provide a business update. As previously announced, the call will take place on **Wednesday, November 4, 2026 at 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time (4:30 p.m. Eastern Time).**


The call will be led by Chairman and Chief Executive Officer[Khurram Sheikh](https://pr.report/t1gj) , who is expected to discuss the Company's financial performance, the integration of EngineRoom, commercial and product developments, operating efficiency initiatives and progress toward its previously announced goal of achieving positive operating cash flow by the third quarter of 2027.


**Conference Call Details**


- **Date:** Wednesday, November 4, 2026


- **Time:** 1:30 p.m. Pacific Time / 4:30 p.m. Eastern Time


- **Webcast registration and access:**[https://event.webcasts.com/starthere.jsp?ei=1781669&tp_key=e6b7f14481](https://pr.report/t1gk)


- **Listen by phone (US/Canada toll-free):** 800 330 6730


- **Listen by phone (direct):** +1 646 769 9500


- **Passcode:** 415343#


Interested parties are encouraged to register for the webcast in advance. It is not necessary to dial in unless you are unable to join the webcast. Phone participants will be in listen-only mode.


**Replay**


A replay of the webcast will be available at the same link within 48 hours following the conclusion of the call. Additional information is available on the CXAI investor relations website at[ir.cxapp.com](https://pr.report/t1gl) .


**About CXApp Inc.**


[CXApp Inc.](https://pr.report/t1gm) is an enterprise agentic AI platform company focused on helping organizations improve productivity, automate workflows and enhance business performance through artificial intelligence.


The Company's platform combines operational intelligence, analytics, workplace technologies and intelligent automation to deliver measurable business outcomes across enterprise and mid-market organizations.


CXAI serves customers across technology, financial services, healthcare, media and other industries while expanding its AI capabilities through both organic growth and strategic acquisitions.
